abilities.name: Cultivate plant
abilities.function: Plant one owned root unit in a small soil plot as a persistent trial, inspect a plot by direct observation, or take back remaining planted material; resume or cancel unfinished planting.
abilities.costs: Plant: one owned unspoiled root unit (quantity 1); two work rounds at one energy each, at an unoccupied ordinary-soil x/y within 0.65 plus body radius; supply inputStackId. Resume/cancel use personal processId. Inspect: one round and 0.2 energy, the baseline probe observation of a plot in reach (target). Remove: one round and 1 energy, planter only (target). Tend is unavailable and spends nothing. No tools or water are granted.
abilities.effects: Completed planting places the real root unit in the plot; it keeps ageing under existing environmental decay while the planter is absent. Plot state records stage, observation rounds, soil moisture and temperature/rain exposure. There is no propagation, growth, harvest or replenishment rule for roots, so a plot never produces food. Inspect records only visible state. Remove returns only the material that physically remains, never a replacement; the emptied plot remains. Cancel releases unplanted material once; death releases it on the ground. Spent effort is never refunded. No reward for planting, inspecting or removing; genuine observed changes use the existing evidence-deduplicated probe feedback only.

execution.progress: Planting is paid work whose exact job and escrow persist across interruption; resume pays only remaining work and cancellation/death settles once. Inspect and remove are atomic one-round actions.

abilities.name: Controlled food processing trial
abilities.function: Place one or two whole units of an owned food on the ground as a paired exposure trial, inspect their quantity and decay, end the observation or retrieve what remains.
abilities.costs: Start: inputStackId of an owned, unspoiled, nontoxic food, quantity 1 or 2 whole units (default 2), and an unoccupied ordinary-ground x/y within 0.65 plus body radius; two work rounds at one energy each. Resume/cancel use personal processId. Inspect: target trial in reach, one round and 0.2 energy. Retrieve: operator only, one round and one energy. Cancel of an exposed trial ends observation at no cost. No supports, tools, water or fuel are used or granted.
abilities.effects: Completed setup places the samples at two ground positions 0.2 apart under the same ambient conditions; with one unit there is no matched control. No food moisture, drying or preservation model exists in this world: both samples keep the existing decay rules, so no treatment difference, preserved status, safety certification or extended lifetime is produced. The trial records rounds exposed and marks a 10-round observation checkpoint; ageing continues while unattended and after the checkpoint. Inspect records sample quantity and decay as a personal unverified record. Retrieve returns only the remaining material, never a replacement. Setup interruption keeps paid work; cancel releases reserved food once; death releases it on the ground. Spent effort is never refunded. No reward for starting, inspecting or retrieving.

execution.progress: Setup is paid work whose exact job and escrow persist across interruption; resume pays only remaining work and cancellation/death settles once. Inspect, retrieve and ending observation are atomic.

Following the specification's own fallback, the existing root resource has no propagating structure, growth, biomass or yield model, so no supported facts establish viable material: the executable precursor is a physical planting trial with recorded survival or decay, and replenishment remains unverified. Plant uses exactly one owned unspoiled root unit (quantity 1 enforced), an unoccupied ordinary-soil 0.2-radius plot in reach, and two paid work rounds of 1 energy each with exact escrow, interruption, resume, cancel and death handling; the unit is transferred into the plot, never duplicated, and keeps ageing under existing environmental decay while the planter is absent. Inspect is the unchanged baseline probe observation (one round, 0.2 energy, visible state only, existing evidence-deduplicated feedback), not a new diagnostic. Tend is unavailable and spends nothing: plots are made on bare soil, no competing cover is represented on them in this scope, and irrigation needs an implemented water input. Remove (one round, 1 energy, planter only) returns only physically remaining material and leaves an emptied plot. No growth, harvest, food, comfort or satisfaction rule is added and no reward for planting, inspecting or removing. Assumptions recorded: one unit per trial; reach 0.65 plus body radius; no hidden viability is shown. Reuse: the ex13 root-planting-trial@1 placement, escrow and ageing code is parameterized by plot revision and work-state key with ex13 defaults unchanged, plus collective-work and the baseline probe; this is recorded implementation reuse, not reinvention, and no ex13 ability, plot or mastery is inherited. Visuals reuse the existing plant component with prepared, planted-unverified and decayed states. Tests cover scope, study, paid planting, conservation, inspection, refused tending, no food growth and planter-only removal.

Reviewed Lin's round-9 request (root propagation and tending) and the accepted world-16 develop review (learning 3). The review asks the handoff to author species parameters for root propagation: viable propagules, establishment duration, growth rate, resource demands and finite yield. Inspection of the implementation shows no such biology: wild sources regrow their own finite stock, and a gathered root unit has only nutrition, toxicity and decay; no rule makes a root unit establish, grow or yield. Under this run's operating rule the developer does not author new physical or biological rules that the world does not already contain, so biological support remains unresolved. Following the review's own instruction for that case, the trial is preserved as unresolved with an explicit blocker rather than reported as failure or shipped as growth: no new package, mode or rule is installed. Lin is assigned the existing general cultivate-plant operation (learning 3, equal to the reviewed duration), whose contract and plot state already state that there is no propagation, growth, harvest or replenishment rule and that viability is unverified; planting, baseline-probe inspection, refused tending and planter-only removal stay exactly as implemented in cultivate-plant@1. Tending remains unavailable because no competing cover or water transfer is represented. Blocker recorded for the human: a propagation model would need explicit, separately decided biological parameters; none are invented here. No source, budget, goal or experiment policy changes; no reward is added.

Reviewed Sol's round-10 request (evidence-based preservation of roots or berries) and the accepted world-21 develop review (learning 3). The review requires a versioned per-resource moisture and spoilage model before any changed shelf life, and otherwise enables only the paired exposure-and-observation precursor in which both samples keep existing decay rules and no preserved status is awarded. Inspection found no defensible model for this world: food stacks carry only quantity, origin, harvest round and decay, and resources a static moisture property. The ex12 drying physics depends on a different food representation with per-sample water state and was not reused, because porting it would add new physics to this world. Implemented controlled-food-processing-trial@1 in scope long-ex14 as that precursor, a general operation for any learned actor and any owned, unspoiled, nontoxic food. Start places one or two whole units (default 2) at two ground positions 0.2 apart under the same ambient conditions, in two paid work rounds of one energy each, with exact escrow portions that keep origin, age and decay; a single unit is recorded as having no matched control. The raised bark-and-branch support from the review is not required, because without a drying model it would have no physical effect and its stability and contact safety cannot be validated; this deviation is stated in the contract. Samples keep ageing under existing decay while unattended; the trial records rounds exposed and a predeclared 10-round observation checkpoint. Inspect (one round, 0.2 energy, in reach) records quantity and decay as a personal unverified record. Retrieve (operator only, one round, one energy) returns only the remaining material. Cancel releases unfinished setup once; on an exposed trial it ends observation without moving food; death releases setup material on the ground. No nutrition change, safety certificate, extended lifetime or reward is added. Tests cover paid placement, distinct positions, conservation, identical decay of both samples, the checkpoint, unverified inspection records, operator-only retrieval and cancellation.

reviews.reason: The supplied search and registry review found no equivalent shelter-building or exposure-reduction operation. gather already supplies loose-material collection; probe supplies observation and small physical trials. Planting and food-exposure trials do not construct weather barriers. Develop the missing construction and maintenance mechanism through the current-conversation handoff, reusing those existing operations rather than claiming their reinvention. Lin has neither qualified building materials nor demonstrated construction mastery. Visible fallen branches are potential sources, not inventory or verified suitable stock. A small branch windbreak is a feasible minimal shelter; rainproof roofing, enclosed housing and emergency protection are not established.
reviews.experienceReview: Proposed learning is four individual study rounds, 0.2 energy per completed round, with resumable paid study progress through learn; no automatic learning on approval. Learning, requests, registration, naming and mastery confer no experiential reward. For the minimal implementation add no new pleasure or satisfaction award: construction progress alone is not evidence of experienced comfort. Genuine observed protection or informative structural failure may use the existing evidence-deduplicated probe feedback only when actually measured and personally applicable, preserving that system's bounded amount, cooldown and decay; if its contract cannot be verified, issue no such award. Familiar maintenance can remain legitimate useful activity without inventing novelty bonuses. Any future maintained satisfaction requires its own coded event eligibility, shared functional deduplication and caps rather than a reward per repair. Keep basic nutrition, protected reward accounts, budgets, goals and permissions unchanged.
reviews.visualReview: Emit observable work-started, material-embedded, paused, resumed, cancelled, completed, inspected, exposure-changed, repaired, dismantled and collapsed events with actor, tick, site/target IDs, recipe version, paid progress and observable input/output changes. Store reusable renderer metadata: component branch-screen, dimensions, orientation, construction fraction, integrity band, unfinished/complete/damaged/collapsed state, lee-side footprint and current measured protection-active flag. Show actual partial geometry for unfinished work and weathered or collapsed geometry as condition changes. Protection indicators require an eligible occupant, actual directional wind and successful environmental computation; calm weather, failed placement, missing materials, unfinished work and unsupported coupling must never display protection success. Private or unobserved resource facts must not appear in visuals or events delivered to observers. Completion means a real built screen, not proof of rain protection or a guaranteed positive comfort experience.
reviews.specification:
Develop a general capability named Construct and maintain a weather barrier, parameterized by site, orientation, owned input stack IDs, target structure/process ID and mode: build, resume, inspect, repair, cancel or dismantle. Initial supported design: a freestanding, densely interlaced branch screen with a one-person lee-side resting footprint, not a waterproof roof. Development must implement its physical structure and environmental coupling before publishing a working interface; review and implementation waiting advance no simulation time. If source materials or environmental exposure integration are unavailable, report the exact unsupported condition and perform no successful construction or protection. Do not substitute a decorative object.
Prerequisites: individual completion of learning; reachable, unoccupied ordinary-soil footprint, 2 m by 1 m, with a clear adjacent 1 m by 1 m lee-side space; soil that accepts driven stakes; no interference with other occupants, entrances or access rights. Check placement against actual collision and bounds. No tools are assumed. The hand-driven design is restricted to demonstrably workable soil and branches; otherwise it cannot start. Use probe's existing observation/test behavior when qualification needs an actual test, charging its existing costs, and record code reuse. Never infer mechanical suitability from a resource name.
Proposed executable material recipe: 12 whole, sound branch units, each with recorded length at least 1.2 m and diameter between 1 and 3 cm: four stakes and eight interwoven members. Qualify flexibility, integrity and hand-workability from public material properties or paid physical testing. These are input requirements, not assertions about local branches. Existing gather transfers only finite exposed source stock, at its existing 2 energy per unit and range conditions; gathering, travel and recovery are separate actual actions. Food stacks item-3-lin-12 and item-19-lin-87 are not substitutes. Where current branch records lack necessary physical properties, the handoff must add a truthful material representation/qualification mechanism, not generate suitable branches. No cordage, tools, new source stock or roofing material is granted.
Build costs eight successful work rounds at 2 energy per round, plus the 12 qualified branch units. Validate and reserve exact owned units and the site atomically on the first paid work action. No remote construction. After each round store worker, site, orientation, recipe version, input IDs and quantities, paid energy and completed steps. Rounds 1-2 place stakes, rounds 3-8 interweave members; material accounting records each embedded member. Completed branches remain structure contents rather than also remaining in inventory. No unworked or partially worked screen provides registered shelter protection. Lin's current energy does not imply the ability to pay gathering, travel and construction without recovery. Ordinary hunger, ageing and weather continue during actual learning and work rounds. Never debit below affordable energy or invent nutrition.
On completion create a persistent structure with actual collision geometry, anchored location, orientation, branch inventory, integrity 100, capacity one and a bounded lee-side polygon. The environmental integration must derive a local wind-exposure component from actual weather. While an actor independently occupies the unobstructed lee-side polygon, wind comes through the screen toward that polygon, and integrity is at least 25, reduce only that wind-exposure component by 30% times integrity/100. Blend direction continuously to zero for side-on or reversed wind. Do not reduce ambient temperature, rain, wet-ground exposure, hunger or all-purpose hazard damage. There is no rainproofing, heating, food production or guaranteed rest bonus. If no wind component exists, implement that minimal coupling in the handoff or explicitly mark protection unavailable; do not apply an unexplained global exposure multiplier. Log the actual before/after wind contribution whenever the effect changes. In calm mild conditions a completed screen can have zero current protective effect. Overlapping barriers use the strongest applicable reduction, not multiplication. Any physical comfort contribution must remain within the global cap of 10.
Maintain integrity in code: lose 0.05 integrity per elapsed outdoor simulation round, plus 0.05 times normalized actual wind intensity in [0,1] and 0.05 times normalized actual rain intensity in [0,1]. Do not fabricate weather observations; absent weather channels contribute zero and remain declared limitations. Integrity is clamped to [0,100]; below 25 no protection, at zero mark collapsed and retain the same physical material as damaged debris. Ageing persists unattended; no automatic maintenance or energy drain from the builder. Inspect uses probe's one-round, 0.2-energy direct-observation path and reports only visible structure condition and actual locally measurable effects. Repair requires access to the structure, one new qualified branch unit and two work rounds at 1 energy each; replace one existing member and add at most 10 integrity, capped at 100. Return the replaced member as one damaged, nonqualifying branch unit. Reject repair at full integrity without spending resources. Branch ageing/damage must be represented so repair or rebuilding cannot reset degraded material for free.
Interruption pauses work with paid progress and reserved inputs retained; environmental damage and material ageing continue. Resume rechecks reach, occupancy, material condition and prerequisites, retaining valid paid progress and charging only new work. Cancel releases unembedded reserved inputs exactly once; installed materials remain in the unfinished structure with no protective effect until completed. Never refund spent rounds, energy or learning. Death stops work, releases reservations as actual ground items and leaves embedded materials and any completed structure in place; no duplicate refund or automatic inheritance of learning. Dismantle requires two rounds at 1 energy each, disables protection when dismantling starts, and returns only the recorded surviving branch contents at their current condition. Paused dismantling retains its state. Destruction and weather damage transfer or degrade real contents rather than producing replacement stock. No expiry or cancellation deletes accounted material without an explicit physical loss record.
Each worker must independently learn, communicate and choose paid actions; the initial implementation need not support joint work. No request authorizes another actor's labor or transfers ownership. Record reuse of gather, probe, normal inventory transfers, learn, collision checks and any available persistent-work/event infrastructure. New code is limited to the missing barrier assembly, material condition, ongoing integrity and directional exposure coupling. Execute established checks, costs and effects deterministically in code, not through repeated model review.
